subject: angol
title: Spending and budgeting
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a fogyasztói társadalomról és a felelős pénzkezelésről.

scenes.description: It is Black Friday morning at a large electronics store. As soon as the doors open, a crowd of shoppers rushes in, and two men are pulling at the same box with a huge TV in it. A security guard is trying to calm people down, and there are red signs everywhere saying 'Today only – up to 70% off'. Some people are filming the chaos on their phones.

A young couple are sitting at their kitchen table in the evening with a laptop, a calculator and a pile of bills. The woman is typing numbers into a spreadsheet, and the man is putting some coins into a glass jar labelled 'Holiday 2027'. A calendar on the wall has the dates of payments circled in red. They look concentrated but calm.

prompts: Compare the attitudes to money and shopping shown in the two pictures.
Why do people often buy things they don't need?
How can young people learn to manage their money responsibly?
followUpQuestions: Have you ever bought something in a sale that you later regretted?
Is it better to save money or to enjoy it while you are young? Why?
How has paying by card or phone changed the way people spend money?
Should young people be allowed to take out loans? Under what conditions?

usefulPhrases.en: The first picture reflects ..., while the second ...
usefulPhrases.hu: Az első kép ...-t tükrözi, míg a második ...

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text:
Both pictures are about money and shopping, but they show completely opposite attitudes. The first one shows Black Friday in a huge electronics store. A crowd of shoppers is rushing in, two men are pulling at the same TV, and a security guard is trying to calm everyone down. With red signs everywhere saying 'up to 70% off', it all looks rather chaotic. In the second picture, a young couple are sitting at their kitchen table in the evening, going through their bills. The woman is typing numbers into a spreadsheet, while the man is putting coins into a jar labelled 'Holiday 2027'. They seem calm and in control.
I'd say the people in the first picture are acting on impulse, whereas the couple are planning carefully for the future. People often buy things they don't need because sales create a sense of urgency: you feel that if you don't buy it today, you'll miss out. In my opinion, young people should learn to manage money both at home and at school, for example by keeping a simple budget like this couple.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you ever bought something in a sale that you later regretted?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, a pair of wireless headphones last Black Friday. They were half price, so I bought them without reading any reviews, and they broke after two months. Now I always ask myself whether I'd buy something at full price, too.

notes: Összefüggő témakifejtés: a vizsgázó mindkét jelenetet részletesen leírja, az összehasonlítást egy világos ellentétre építi (hirtelen ötletből vásárlás kontra tudatos tervezés), megmagyarázza, miért veszünk felesleges dolgokat, javaslatot tesz a fiatalok pénzügyi nevelésére, és saját rossz vásárlásával zárja a választ.
Szókincs: a pénzügyek és a vásárlás pontos szókincse (acting on impulse, a sense of urgency, miss out, keeping a simple budget, at full price) és jól tagolt felépítés (I'd say, In my opinion).

Nyelvhelyesség: Present Continuous a leírásban, 'whereas' ellentét, első feltételes (if you don't buy it today, you'll miss out) és második feltételes (whether I'd buy something at full price) – változatos és hibátlan szerkezetek.
Érdemes megtanulni: „acting on impulse”, „They seem calm and in control”, „create a sense of urgency”, „you'll miss out”.
